title: 云南菌子季①见手青：炒不够时间，真会"见小人" | Yunnan Wild Mushrooms P1 · Jianshouqing 🍄
description:
一盘见手青，你敢吃吗？评论区说说。

【云南菌子季·第1集 见手青】云南人吃菌子，先立一条规矩。见手青是牛肝菌的一种，一切开伤口马上氧化成靛蓝——"见手就青"，名字由此而来。它没炒熟含毒素，中毒潜伏6到72小时，会头晕、呕吐，甚至产生"看见小人"的幻觉。所以老规矩是：炒够20分钟、趁热吃，凉菌绝不能碰。2026年6月，云南一位医生因为没炒透，中毒昏迷了两天。规矩守住，才配吃更贵的那几朵。

Ep.1 Jianshouqing. In Yunnan, wild mushrooms come with a rule. This bolete oxidizes to indigo the moment you cut it — "touch it, it greens." Undercooked, it is toxic: 6–72h latency, dizziness, vomiting, even hallucinations of "little people." The rule: fry a full 20 minutes, eat it hot, never cold. In June 2026 a doctor undercooked it and spent two days in a coma. Keep the rule, and you earn the pricier mushrooms.

AI-assisted edit; the bilingual subtitles are the narration — no voiceover. Facts checked this run; sources below. Food culture & safety note, not medical or dietary advice. Footage licensed from Pexels (credited below).
